posts.subject: Ban apology for calladmin abuse
posts.bodyHtml:
I want to apology to @Doo Doo for calladmin abuse because there was a bhopper on the server that was legit hard to kill and I did get a bit mad about it and without thinking I dropped more reports on him as he was changing his name so when admin joined he will not be banned ( that's what he thought ) but I did not mean to report him soo many times that I will be banned it's just that he changed his name to someone else and thought he will get away with it.


I'm really sorry again @Doo Doo

Hi Oxygen,


To be honest, I don't think your ban apology was that sincere at all. In addition to that, you have been banned previously for abusing !calladmin and also, you didn't really seem that regretful and apologetic on the server whilst I was banning you, you were simply just laughing and saying "Oh RIP Oxygen" which really doensn't show any maturity or sorrow at all.


I decide to remain on my ground and let the ban endure for the rest of its' time.


We hope you use this time effectively to reflect on your actions and we hope you will come back to our Dream servers after your ban.


Thank you,
Doo Doo

I did not mean to make it calladmin abuse but literally the hacker pushed my buttons to the limit after he changed his name into other players names which for me was a bit of over the top cheating so I reported him at the names he had to keep admins aware that he changed his name


//EDIT: I was also saying " oh RIP OxygeN" Because I know this will end like this for me and I did not really mean to abuse it that hard I would be banned, I do want to comeback to Dream and enjoy playing with this community asap

Nevertheless, if there was no admin online, you shouldn't spam the calladmin, there is simply no point to keep reporting the person if no admins are available.


If you have no other reasons, then this shall be my final decision.


No further action was taken, you are still banned from our servers for now.


Thanks,
Doo Doo

This thereat can be now closed after having a long talk with @Nachtfrische and @Doo Doo


[closesnew*] pleas @Nachtfrische
